run_occlusion_plot: run the occlusion plot script to generate pose error vs occlusion graphs for neuralfeels experiments
run_pose_error_vs_occlusion: run pose_error_vs_occlusion to plot pose error against occlusion levels for a list of experiments
run_pose_errors_vs_camera_frustums: run pose_errors_vs_camera_frustums to plot pose errors against camera frustum configurations
run_main_with_log_path: run the main function with a Hydra config specifying log_path to generate occlusion and frustum plots
run_experiment_sweep_analysis: run the experiment sweep analysis to find all stats.pkl files and generate occlusion and frustum plots
